channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Micah Nori | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Micah Nori from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: JB Bickerstaff on Micah Nori
item.description:
NBA coaches association president J.B. Bickerstaff on Micah Nori’s year-to-year contract with Portland:

“From our perspective, it's like someone's taking advantage of your dream and devaluing what we feel like coaches have earned over the years.”

JB Bickerstaff on Micah Nori, Jun 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Chris Finch on Micah Nori
item.description:
Jon Krawczynski:Chris Finch on Micah Nori filling in:

“I'm trying to get this guy a job. How far do I have to go to get this guy off my staff?”

Chris Finch on Micah Nori, Dec 22, 2025. Source: Twitter @JonKrawczynski.

item.title: Chris Finch on Micah Nori
item.description:
Chris Finch on Micah Nori:

“We’re very much on the same wavelength. We share a brain. If you know Micah, it’s not the type of brain you want to share with most people. But we are very much in sync.”

Chris Finch on Micah Nori, May 5, 2024. Source: Twitter @ChristopherHine.
